test_title: SSC MTS Previous Year Paper (Held on: 13 Oct 2021 Shift 1)
subject: general
question: The median of a set of 11 distinct observations is 17.5. If each of the largest 5 observations of the set is increased by 3, then the median of the new set:

options.text: is three times of the original number
remains the same as that of the original set

solution:
**Given:**

The median of the set of 11 distinct observations is 17.5.

**Concept used:**

Median of set of n observation = [(n + 1)/2]th observation

**Calculation:**

[(n + 1)/2]th observation observation = 6th observation

∵ The 6th observation is not changed.

**∴ The median of the new set remains the same.**
